amendments.reason: Prometheus's HTTP API reference documents the instant query GET /api/v1/query with query and an optional evaluation time; the pinned Grafana document declares the data-source proxy only as GET /datasources/proxy/uid/{uid}/{datasource_proxy_route} below its one server /api, one path parameter standing for the whole sub-path, so the sub-path of a Prometheus data source's instant query is fixed here. Its uid is held to Grafana's data-source uid rule, letters, digits, - and _, at most 40 characters (ValidateUID in https://github.com/grafana/grafana/blob/v13.3.1/pkg/util/shortid_generator.go, which data-source create and update apply), so a uid is always one path segment.

Its uid is held to Grafana's data-source uid rule, letters, digits, - and _, at most 40 characters (ValidateUID in https://github.com/grafana/grafana/blob/v13.3.1/pkg/util/shortid_generator.go, which data-source create and update apply), so a uid is always one path segment.
